comments.comment: How about they just mind their own business? Much simpler

First of all, I live in Massachusetts. We do care for babies and children. We are the only state in which, no county voted for tRump. IF voters in those states had better education, health care and representation their world would be better! Massachusetts is an expensive state to live in today. However, we have fabulous education and world renowned hospitals. Our population is well educated ( many have college degrees). You've raised some good points on complex issues. Demand better, every vote counts, too. I am not voting for any republican in November nor, will I vote for anyone over 65y.o. We need term and age limits! Our nation will need to reconstruct after tRump dies or is impeached. FYI, I have taught from Early headstart to middle school in poor areas of Boston. My area is students with special needs or neurodivergent issues. More funding for pregnancy health and more education funds at state and federal levels.😢

I hear you, and this sounds good in theory, but as someone who lost 4 pregnancies (6 babies), I would've hated to re-live my trauma every single time I would have had to file all kinds of paperwork because those children didn't make it 😢
